[SWS_ANM_00023]
⌈
If Repeat Message Request Bit (set in the CBV of the received
NM message) is received in the Ready Sleep State, the Ready Sleep State shall be
left and the Repeat Message State shall be entered.
⌋
(RS_Nm_00047)
Note:
Handling of multiple transition conditions which might arise at the same time
(e.g. NM-Timeout timer expires vs. network is requested) is considered to be
implementation-specific.
